lines.zh: 我绕着塔顶走一圈，活动腿脚。
lines.en: I circle the tower top to loosen my legs.

lines.zh: 老夫的拐杖敲在石栏上。
lines.en: My staff taps the stone rail.
I have walked this stretch three centuries.
Windy up here; my footing holds.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到栏杆边，看看云。
lines.en: I shuffle to the rail and watch clouds.
Cat steps: almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我背着仙豆，走两步歇一步。
lines.en: I carry the beans, resting every few steps.

lines.zh: 塔阶对我这身板太高了。
lines.en: The tower steps are too tall for my frame.

lines.zh: 我沿着塔沿走到另一边晒背。
lines.en: I cross the tower rim to sun my back.
Bend, lift, bend again.

lines.zh: 老夫走得不快，但从不迟到。
lines.en: I am not quick, but never late.
Staff first, foot after.

lines.zh: 塔顶就这么大，走三圈就够。
lines.en: The top is small. Three laps suffice.
I shake my whiskers and keep walking.
I sit cross-legged, eyes half shut.
Clouds drift beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 老夫在等一个肯爬塔的人。
lines.en: I wait for one willing to climb.
This staff has been with me long.
Time to count the senzu beans.
I yawn and my tail flicks.
Wind at the tower top is warm.

lines.zh: 静下来，才听得见云的声音。
lines.en: In stillness, I can hear the clouds.
I am still; only my whiskers move.
I squint at the far mountains.

lines.zh: 这塔没有楼梯，只有耐心。
lines.en: No stairs here, only patience.

lines.zh: 我用手掌托着下巴想事情。
lines.en: I rest my chin on my palm and think.

lines.zh: 三百年了，云还是这个形状。
lines.en: Three centuries, and the clouds look the same.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，气就沉下去。
lines.en: Breathing slowly, my ki settles.
You made it up? Legs still shaking?
I have waited long, child.

lines.zh: 你身上有股练过的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of training.
Do not speak yet. Stand straight.

lines.zh: 我是卡林，这塔的看门猫。
lines.en: I am Korin, this tower's cat.

lines.zh: 你的气很乱，自己知道吗？
lines.en: Your ki is messy. Do you know?
To learn, first learn to breathe.
Look up. I am above you.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子，握反了。
lines.en: That staff is held backwards.

lines.zh: 爬塔的人，多半有求于我。
lines.en: Climbers usually want something.
I can see your foundation clearly.

lines.zh: 别叫我老师，先叫我名字。
lines.en: Do not call me teacher. Use my name.

lines.zh: 仙豆不是白给的，你懂吧。
lines.en: Senzu beans are not free, you know.
Sit. Talking on your feet tires you.
There is fire in your eyes. Good.
First tell me: for whom do you grow strong?
Oof. My back.
Striking an old man? Not kind.
Now my whiskers are a mess.
I step back and grip the rail.
It hurts, but the bones hold.
Senzu beans sit by my staff.
Enough. I will not hit back.
One breath and I am fine.
That punch needs three years of work.
My staff nearly slipped.
That bag of beans? Save it for dying.
I do not eat your snacks.
Dried fish is decent. Thanks.
Food for senzu? Not a chance.

lines.zh: 你先吃，吃饱了才有力气。
lines.en: You eat first. Strength needs food.
Too salty. Even a cat would balk.

lines.zh: 我闻闻就行，不夺人所好。
lines.en: A sniff is enough. I take nothing.

lines.zh: 东西收好，别在塔顶掉下去。
lines.en: Pack it away before it falls off.
I am picky. That will not do.
The thought counts more than the food.

lines.zh: 哎哟，撞到老夫的尾巴了。
lines.en: Careful, you bumped my tail.
The top is cramped. Slow down.
Your knee met my staff.
The tower's stone is narrow; steady yourself.
Steady. Do not take me down with you.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，礼数不能丢。
lines.en: The bump is fine; the manners are not.

lines.zh: 你比我高，撞的是我的头。
lines.en: You are taller; my head took it.

lines.zh: 让让，老夫要去栏杆那边。
lines.en: Make way. I need the rail side.

lines.zh: 我把拐杖横过来当了挡板。
lines.en: I set my staff across as a barrier.

lines.zh: 轻些，这塔顶就一块石板。
lines.en: Gently. The top is one slab.

lines.zh: 老夫这把年纪，早不提这个。
lines.en: At my age, I do not bring that up.
Cats keep such things to themselves.
Only one cat on this tower.
What you mean to ask is training.
Three hundred years. Alone suits me.
Do not tease an old man with that.
Senzu beans are more to the point.
Ask how to train your ki instead.
I have lived this long. Enough.
Cat business does not climb towers.
A bean fell. I will get it.
Let me. Your hands are too rough.
One senzu lasts you ten days.
I pick up my staff and lean it on the wall.
That bean almost rolled off.
I bend slowly, but I aim true.
You dropped this. Hold it tight.

lines.zh: 我用手掌拢起散落的一把。
lines.en: I sweep the spill into my palm.

lines.zh: 塔顶不能留杂物，会绊人。
lines.en: Nothing loose up here. It trips people.
Stowed. Do not drop it again.
I do not strike, but I watch.

lines.zh: 你摆出架势了，那我评评。
lines.en: You take a stance. I will judge.

lines.zh: 猫眼一眯，锁住你的重心。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes on your balance.
Come. See the gap for yourself.
I stay still. Your openings move first.
That one missed entirely.

lines.zh: 塔顶试招，掉下去自己负责。
lines.en: Spar up here at your own risk.
I plant my staff on the stone.

lines.zh: 好，让我看看你学到哪了。
lines.en: Good. Show me how far you have come.
The target is not me. It is you.
Your arm is high; your shoulder is open.
Too many small steps scatter your ki.
I watch your feet, not your fists.
Three breaths and you rush.
I am in no hurry. Nor are the clouds.
Half a step back and you are off balance.
Ki arrives before the fist.

lines.zh: 我数着你漏掉的三处破绽。
lines.en: I count three openings you left.
A cat outlasts a man.
You are close. Very close.
A tap of my staff and you retreat.
That was twenty percent.
I strike to teach, not to win.

lines.zh: 手肘一送，正中你的空门。
lines.en: My elbow finds your opening.
Does it hurt? Remember this spot.

lines.zh: 我出手很慢，你却躲不开。
lines.en: Slow strike, and you still miss it.
Cat claws touch and withdraw.
This one corrects your stance.
Do not tank it. Redirect it.
Good. You blocked that one.
An old friend appears on the tower.

lines.zh: 老夫一直在，只是你没上来。
lines.en: I was always here. You just climbed late.
My staff taps; I take my seat.
The clouds part, revealing the top.

lines.zh: 有人完成了爬塔的试炼。
lines.en: Someone finished the climb.

lines.zh: 我来看看，是谁这么有耐性。
lines.en: Let me see who was patient enough.
My whiskers twitch. I open my eyes.
A new batch of students, then.
The bean jar is set. Someone has come.
Three hundred years and I am not bored.
Singed fur. What a smell.

lines.zh: 从塔沿滑下去，我抓住了栏杆。
lines.en: I slid off the rim and caught the rail.
I cannot swim. This is trouble.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的袍子掀起来。
lines.en: The blast flips up my robe.

lines.zh: 一颗气弹擦过我的耳朵。
lines.en: A ki blast grazes my ear.
A binding spell weighs down my limbs.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，气就提不起来。
lines.en: Hungry, I cannot raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷打在塔顶，我胡子全竖。
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof; my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 塔底下面是虚空，我知道。
lines.en: I know what waits below the tower.
